name: Michihiro Ikemizu
biography: Japanese voice actor from Kanagawa Prefecture and a graduate of Waseda University who works for Aoni Production. Among his other roles, he has performed the characters Onsen-Mark (Urusei Yatsura), Isao Ohta (Mobile Police Patlabor) and Kinnikuman Super Phoenix (Kinnikuman: Scramble for the Throne).
movies: Kamen Rider SD: Strange?! Kumo Otoko
